subject.title: fix(agents): treat codex exec_command as exec-like

question: Should maintainers require live Codex app-server proof for this PR, or accept the sibling Codex source contract plus focused OpenClaw tests as sufficient proof?
rationale: The code direction is sound, but external PR proof is still test/source-only and current OpenClaw projection leaves a live producer-path ambiguity that automation should not override.

options.title: Require live warning-path proof
options.body: Ask for redacted Codex app-server terminal output, logs, copied live output, or a recording after a branch refresh before merge.

options.title: Accept source-contract proof
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly override the real-behavior proof gate based on the inspected Codex source contract and focused OpenClaw tests.

options.title: Pause until producer evidence exists
options.body: Keep or close the branch only after deciding no live or producer-path evidence is likely to arrive.

recommendation.title: Require live warning-path proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted Codex app-server terminal output, logs, copied live output, or a recording after a branch refresh before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest recent routing candidate for the shared agent tool mutation and warning surfaces touched by this PR.
